matrix_convention: S[row output port, column input port]; b=S a
normalization: native dimensionless complex field coefficients; power normalization assumed for numerical passivity screening, not independently established
reference_planes: PCell port coordinates archived; FDTD de-embedding and exact modal planes not independently established
phase: upstream exp(+i*phase polynomial); phase radians; phasor time convention not independently documented
validity: exploratory grid only; upstream certified interval and uncertainty unknown
polarization: not independently specified in source coefficient JSON; compatible native optical mode assumed
geometry_scope: same pinned PDK factory name and nominal default PCell; exact FDTD geometry and reference-plane equivalence not established
source_type: upstream simulated polynomial fit, not raw FDTD or measured S samples
interpolation: native polynomial preferred; no extrapolation; linear complex midpoint error reported separately
